_comment: Crew roster for /dispatch-roadmap. `handle` is referenced as @handle in ROADMAP.md Assignee lines. `linearUserId` is the Linear user GUID (what the dispatcher passes to Linear). `owns` is an advisory list of areas the dispatcher uses when a feature has no explicit assignee. Overlapping `owns` between brett and tanner is intentional: they share organization-management and database-content and may co-own tickets in those areas.
